en.text:
Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Fusion Rifles and Linear Fusion Rifles.

Fusion Rifle and Linear Fusion Rifle Kills grant <solar/>Radiant for 7.5 seconds (11.25 with <solar/>Ember of Solace).

Air Dodges refill all equipped weapons from reserves. Air Dodges include both <solar/>Icarus Dash and <strand/>Weavewalk.
